{{Infobox boss | dlc = r | files name = Wormwood (Downpour) | id = 62 | variant = 3 | base hp = 200 | environment = Boss
{{floor|Downpour}}{{floor|Dross}} | pool = {{ip|Boss}}
{{dlc|r+}} {{i|Leech}} (1% chance) }} '''Wormwood''' is a [[boss]] added in ''[[The Binding of Isaac: Repentance]]'' that can appear in {{dlc|r}} {{s|Downpour}} and {{dlc|r}} {{s|Dross}}. __TOC__

sections.Behavior:
* Lunges from a pit towards Isaac, releasing 4 projectiles in the cardinal directions in the air. Wormwood then chases Isaac in a zig-zag pattern, before eventually returning to a pit.
** If Wormwood lunges out of a pit and lands on top of another large pit, he returns back into that pit.
** Eats any {{e|Bomb}}s dropped in his path same as {{e|Chub}} while chasing Isaac, stunning him for a moment before dealing considerable damage.
* Partially emerges from a pit and fires a spray of disorganized projectiles at Isaac before re-submerging.
* At 33% health, Wormwood pierces the ground with his tail at Isaac's location with a short delay 3-6 times. Pits are created where Wormwood pierces the ground. Afterwards, Wormwood charges out from inside the left or right wall horizontal to Isaac's location while spawning 3 {{e|Small Leech|text=Small Leeches}}. He then chases Isaac for a short duration before returning to a pit.
** Wormwood can never create a pit in a spot that would trap Isaac.
** Wormwood takes increasingly reduced damage after reaching 33% HP until he performs this attack and takes only 20% damage while performing this attack.

Triachnid's head hangs down stationary and can perform the following attacks:
* Raises his head, making it invulnerable, and stomps the ground in random locations around the room 3 times in quick succession, leaving small puddles of slowing [[Creep#White Creep|White Creep]]. {{Dlc|r}} One of these legs will always stomp on top of Isaac's position.
** The appendages that he stomps with can be attacked to damage him.
* Lifts his head off-screen and stomps the ground 3 times at regular intervals on top of Isaac's position, leaving a small puddle of White Creep with each stomp. At the end of the stomps, he slams his head down quickly in the center, shooting 8 white projectiles in all directions and creating a large puddle of White Creep. He can only slam his head down along a horizontal plane across the center of the room and slams it down close to Isaac's position.
** Occasionally performs a fourth stomp before slamming his head down and very occasionally performs a fifth.
** Occasionally, when he slams his head down, he leaves a larger puddle of White Creep, but only shoots 4 white projectiles in the cardinal directions.
** The appendages that he stomps with can be attacked to damage him.
* Spits out a {{e|Trite}} in Isaac's direction.
** Trites can be killed by Triachnid's stomps and head slam.
Triachnid's foot stomp and head slam deal a whole heart of contact damage.
sections.Notes:
* {{Dlc|r}} Unlike all other other alternative versions of bosses, such as {{e|Dangle}}, {{e|C.H.A.D.}}, and {{e|Gish}}, Triachnid has the same weight as his alternative boss form.
** Although they share the same weight, Triachnid is actually '''more''' common than {{e|Daddy Long Legs}}, since he also appears in the Scarred Womb.

Ultra Pestilence.infobox:
{{infobox boss | dlc = r | name = Ultra Pestilence | portrait = no | id = 951 | variant = 20 | environment = Boss
{{floor|Home}} | base hp = 1800 | pool = ''None'' }} '''Ultra Pestilence''' is a [[boss]] added in ''[[The Binding of Isaac: Repentance]]'' and is the second of the [[Harbingers (Bosses)#Ultra Harbingers|Ultra Harbingers]] fought before {{e|The Beast}} in {{s|Home}}.

sections.Behavior:
=== Phase 1 ===
Ultra Pestilence spawns with a swarm of {{e|Ultra Pestilence Fly|text=Ultra Pestilence Flies}} that hover around himself for the entire duration of the fight. He has two attacks which he alternates between:
* Launches a large {{i|Ipecac}} projectile at Isaac's position. Upon landing in the lava below, it creates a pillar of poisonous cloud, creates a burst of projectiles that shoot upwards from the lava, and creates 3 additional projectiles that shoot upwards from the lava on both sides of the pillar. This attack is repeated 3 times.
* Fires a large maggot from his eye which flies across the screen, wrapping around three times. Before it completes a fourth wrap, it reverses direction, wrapping around three more times before re-entering Ultra Pestilence's eye. Where the Maggot comes from depends on how many screen wraps it has done:
** After the first screen wrap, the maggot aims at the top third of the arena.
** After the second, third, and fourth screen wrap (the maggot reverses directions after the third), it aims at Isaac.
** After the fifth screen wrap, it aims at the top third of the arena again.
** After the sixth and final screen wrap, it aims at Ultra Pestilence, re-entering his eye when he hits them.

=== Phase 2 ===
After dropping to 40% health,  Ultra Pestilence loses his head, begins to periodically spawn Ultra Pestilence Flies around himself, and uses two attacks:
* At the start of this phase, Ultra Pestilence's steed spawns an {{e|Ultra Pestilence Fly Ball}} which follows Isaac. Attacking this ball of flies spawns additional flies. Ultra Pestilence performs this attack one more time after dropping to 20% health.
* Fires a spray of projectiles from his empty neck, which rain down on the area in front of it.
sections.Notes:
* {{i|Little Horn}} or {{i|Euthanasia}} can kill the maggot projectile.
* {{i|Friendly Ball}} can be used on the maggot projectile.

Ultra Famine.infobox:
{{infobox boss | dlc = r | name = Ultra Famine | portrait = no | id = 951 | variant = 10 | environment = Boss
{{floor|Home}} | base hp = 2000 | pool = ''None'' }} '''Ultra Famine''' is a [[boss]] added in ''[[The Binding of Isaac: Repentance]]'' and is the first of the [[Harbingers (Bosses)#Ultra Harbingers|Ultra Harbingers]] fought before {{e|The Beast}} in {{s|Home}}.

sections.Behavior:
=== Phase 1 ===
Ultra Famine has two attacks which it alternates between:
* Matches Isaac's vertical position and charges off screen. Appears from a random side of a screen and fires a spread of five lines of five projectiles towards Isaac that lose speed before disappearing again. This attack is repeated five times.
* Moves across the screen from one side of the screen to the other, oscillating between the top and bottom of the screen. Ultra Famine spawns a swarm of {{e|Ultra Famine Fly|text=Ultra Famine Flies}} behind himself as he moves. Each fly charges towards Isaac when he is close and continue to move in the same direction until disappearing off screen.

=== Phase 2 ===
After dropping to 1/3rd of his max health, Ultra Famine loses his horse and body becoming only a head. In this phase, Ultra Famine only has one attack which he performs continuously from the center of the screen:
* Continuously fires projectiles in a counter-clockwise pattern, while simultaneously firing 6 bursts of projectiles outwards with alternating orientations.

The Shell always spawns in a pair consisting of 4 body segments and a head segment each. They are always fought in a double-sized room.
* Flies around the room diagonally, bouncing off of walls while dealing contact damage; behaving identically to {{e|The Hollow}}.
** Unlike the Hollow, however, if Isaac is close to the vicinity of its head, it veers slightly in Isaac's direction.
* Normally invincible, but bombs and explosives can destroy its bony exterior (after 15 damage per segment), making its segments vulnerable. There are always one or two {{e|Bomb Grimace}}s that dispense {{e|Throwable Bomb}}s for Isaac to use against The Shell.
* When the armor on their body is destroyed, the exposed flesh segments lose the ability to fly, and will spawn {{e|Fly Bomb}}s if the segment is at the very end, or shoot a volley of three shots at Isaac if the segment is in the middle.
** The Shell moves slower if there are exposed flesh segments attached to its head.
* If a group of conjoined flesh segments have been detached from the head, they chase directly after Isaac at a very slow pace and continue to attack normally.
** If a single flesh segment has been completely detached, it becomes stationary but continues to spawn Fly Bombs.
* The Shell cannot split into smaller copies; when split down the middle, the side containing 3 segments with at least one of end segments having armor turns into a new copy of the boss with one of the armored body segments turning into a head segment.
** Flesh body segments on the shorter side detach and behave normally but armored body segments are automatically destroyed.
* The Shell's head cannot be damaged or destroyed and dies once it loses all its segments.
sections.Notes:
* {{i|Terra}} can destroy the The Shells' armor, along with any items that create rock waves like {{i|Mega Bean}} and {{i|Wait What?}}.
** {{dlc|r+}} {{p|Hagalaz}} will also remove their armor on use.
* {{i|Sulfuric Acid}} tears cannot destroy their armor.
